subject.title: test(shared): add unit tests for tilde path expansion

question: Should maintainers override the external-PR real behavior proof gate for this test-only change, or require contributor proof before merge?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but automation cannot waive the proof gate when the only evidence is mocked unit-test output from an external contributor.

options.title: Require proof before merge
options.body: Keep the proof gate until the contributor adds maintainer-acceptable evidence or a maintainer explicitly overrides it.

options.title: Override for test-only scope
options.body: A maintainer can accept the unit-test-only evidence because the PR adds tests and no runtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Require proof before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the proof gate until the contributor adds maintainer-acceptable evidence or a maintainer explicitly overrides it.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent home-path history and repeated land-ready proof reviews make this the best available routing candidate for a proof-sufficiency choice.
